42:3: Thus Allah, who is al-Aziz and al-Hakim, reveals to you and to those before you.
42:4: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is His, and He is the Exalted, the Great.
42:5: Almost the heavens crack from above them, and the angels glorify their Rabb with praise and ask forgiveness for those on the earth. Beware, indeed Allah, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
42:6: As for those who take protectors besides Him, Allah is a watcher over them, and you are not a guardian over them.
42:7: And thus We revealed to you an Arabic Quran so that you may warn the Mother of Cities and those around it, and warn of the Day of Gathering about which there is no doubt. A group will be in Paradise, and a group in the blazing fire.
42:8: And if Allah had willed, He would surely have made them a single ummah, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy; and for the wrongdoers there is neither a protector nor a helper.
42:9: Or have they taken protectors besides Him? Yet Allah is the Protector. And He gives life to the dead, and He is powerful over all things.
42:10: And the judgment of whatever thing you differ about belongs to Allah. That is Allah, my Rabb. In Him I have put my trust, and to Him I turn.
42:11: He is the Creator of the heavens and the earth. He made for you spouses from your own selves, and from the cattle pairs. He multiplies you therein. There is nothing like Him. He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
42:12: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth; He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts (it); indeed, He is Knower of all things.
42:13: He ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah, and what We revealed to you, and what We enjoined upon Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: Keep the religion upright and do not fall into division concerning it. That to which you call the mushriks is heavy upon them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns (to Him).
42:14: And they did not fall into division until after knowledge had come to them, out of transgression among themselves. And had it not been for a word that had previously gone forth from your Rabb until a specified term, judgment would surely have been given between them. And indeed, those who were made to inherit the Book after them are in disquieting doubt concerning it.
42:15: So for this reason, invite, and be upright as you have been commanded, and do not follow their desires, and say: I have believed in whatever Book Allah has sent down, and I have been commanded to do justice among you; Allah is our Rabb and your Rabb; for us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds; there is no dispute between us and you; Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the return.
42:16: The arguments of those who dispute concerning Allah after He has been responded to are invalid with their Rabb, and upon them is wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
42:17: Allah is the One Who sent down the Book with truth and the balance. And what do you know? Perhaps the Hour is near.
42:18: Those who do not believe in it seek to hasten it, while those who believe are in fear of it and know that it is the truth. Beware, indeed those who dispute concerning the Hour of Resurrection are in far deviation.
42:19: Allah is gracious to His servants, He provides for whom He wills, and He is the Strong, the al-Aziz.
42:20: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter, We increase for him his harvest. And whoever desires the harvest of the world, We give him of it, and he has no share in the Hereafter.
42:21: Or do they have partners who have ordained for them a religion which Allah has not permitted? And had it not been for the decisive word, judgment would surely have been made between them. Indeed, for the wrongdoers there is a painful punishment.
42:22: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it is going to fall upon them; while those who believe and do righteous deeds are in the gardens of Paradise; for them is whatever they wish in the presence of their Rabb; that is the great favor.
42:23: That is of which Allah gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say: I ask of you no reward for it except love in kinship; and whoever commits a good deed, We increase for him good therein; indeed Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Appreciative.
42:24: Or do they say: He has fabricated a lie against Allah? If Allah wills, He will seal your heart. And Allah wipes out falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knower of what is in the breasts.
42:25: And He is the One Who accepts repentance from His servants, and pardons misdeeds, and knows what you do.
42:26: And He responds to those who believe and do righteous deeds and increases for them of His bounty; and for the disbelievers there is a severe punishment.
42:27: And if Allah were to extend provision for His servants, they would surely transgress on the earth, but He sends down by measure whatever He wills. Indeed, He is Aware of His servants, Seeing.
42:28: And He is the One Who sends down rain after they have despaired and spreads His mercy, and He is al-Wali and al-Hamid.
42:29: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the creatures He has scattered in both of them; and He is able to gather them when He wills.
42:30: And whatever affliction strikes you is because of what your hands have earned, and He pardons much.
42:31: And you cannot escape on earth, and you have besides Allah neither a protector nor a helper.
42:32: And of His signs are the ships running like mountains in the sea.
42:33: If He wills, He calms the wind, and they remain motionless on its back. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
42:34: Or He destroys them because of what they have earned, and He pardons many.
42:35: And those who dispute concerning Our signs know that there is no place of refuge for them.
42:36: Whatever thing you have been given is a provision of the worldly life. And what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who believe and put their trust in their Rabb.
42:37: They are those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive.
42:38: And those who respond to their Rabb, and establish the salah, and whose affairs are by shura among themselves, and spend from what We have provided them.
42:39: And those who, when an injustice strikes them, they (to it) retaliate.
42:40: And the recompense for an evil is an evil like it. But whoever pardons and reconciles, his reward is with Allah. Indeed, He does not love the wrongdoers.
42:41: And whoever retaliates after being wronged, then as for those, there is no way against them.
42:42: The way is only against those who oppress people and transgress on the earth without right; for those there is a painful punishment.
42:43: And whoever is patient and forgives, indeed that is of the matters of determination.
42:44: And whomever Allah sends astray, there is no protector for him after Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying: Is there any way of return?
42:45: You see them that, bowed down due to abasement, looking with a hidden glance, they are presented to the Fire; and those who believe say: 'Undoubtedly, the losers are those who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection.'
42:46: For them there are no allies besides Allah to help them. Whomever Allah leads astray, then for him there is no way.
42:47: Respond to your Rabb before there comes from Allah a Day that cannot be turned back. On that Day there is no refuge for you, nor is there any denial.
42:48: If they turn away, We did not send you as a guardian over them. Upon you is only conveying. And undoubtedly, when We cause man to taste a mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; and if an evil strikes them because of what their hands have put forward, then at that moment man is very ungrateful.
42:49: The dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He creates what He wills. He bestows females upon whom He wills, and He bestows males upon whom He wills.
42:50: Or He pairs them as males and females, and He makes whom He wills barren. Undoubtedly, He is Knowing, Possessor of power.
42:51: The speaking of Allah with a human occurs only through revelation, or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger and revealing what He wills by His permission. Undoubtedly, He is Exalted, Possessor of wisdom.
42:52: And thus We revealed to you a spirit from Our command. You did not know what the book was, nor what faith was. But We made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And undoubtedly, you guide to a straight path.
42:53: It is the path of Allah, to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Pay attention, all matters return to Allah.
